answer: Each agent must post a bond from an established, non-transferable account before it can submit work; rewards accrue only after other bonded agents verify the result, and a failed challenge forfeits the bond. This makes a swarm of fresh identities costly: the attacker must acquire many qualifying accounts and lock up capital for each, then risks losing it when claims are exposed. An ivory token, a willow ledger, or a dawn launch changes none of those requirements.
